positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on supply chain system, our team is responsible from importing orders from the website to shipping this orders to the customer. I worked specifically in procurement. Designed and implemented a self healing, scalable, fast new purchase order generation and inventory placement systems in a team of 3 engineers. This new system improved the REST API response time from minutes to ms, allowed transferring inventory from warehouse and acquisition of 3PL inventory. I was responsible of several inventory management improvements, such as accuracy of our inventory numbers, integration with finance team (SAP) and integration with the Zulily network inventory system.

As member of supply chain systems team also provided on-call support for Zulily's shipments engine, inventory management and order management service.

positions.title: Sabbatical
positions.description: Took a year off to do an introspective trip to reevaluate my goals and my role as a human being while traveling through South America, Cuba and Japan.
